neighbours.label: the auxiliary/verb right after 'so <pronoun>' in a consequence clause ('so we were able', 'so it's', 'so I'm')
fire: The bridge was closed, so we were able to take the ferry instead.
She grew up in Lyon, so she's fluent in French.
The bones were found under the floor, so we know they must be older than the house.
I only started last week, so I'm still finding my way around.
The file ends with a slash, so it is treated as a folder.
He trained all winter, so he was ready for the race.
The seeds were dry, so they were able to survive the trip.
It has no battery, so it must be plugged in to work.
quiet: The bridge was closed and we took the ferry instead.
She grew up in Lyon and loves French food.
The bones were found under the floor of the old house.
I only started last week at the new office.
The file ends with a slash and a long name.
He trained all winter for the race in spring.
The seeds were dry after the long trip.
It has no battery and runs on mains power.

notes: Probe: 'so we were able' 0.36, 'so I'm' 0.22, 'so the field was' 0.13.
